prompt: My daughter wants three orange (goldfish) for her new glass tank.
explanation_ru: У слова goldfish форма множественного числа совпадает с единственным числом (без -es).

prompt: Who washes all the dirty (dish) in your flat after dinner?
explanation_ru: Существительные на -sh образуют множественное число с окончанием -es (dishes).

prompt: My brother's spare gym shorts (look) far too wide for basketball practice.
explanation_ru: Слово shorts всегда употребляется во множественном числе и требует глагола без окончания -s (look).

prompt: Hugo printed fifty (copy) of his project before spotting a spelling mistake.
explanation_ru: Если существительное оканчивается на согласную + y, во множественном числе y меняется на -ies (copies).

prompt: Twenty young (child) didn't stop laughing during the short wooden magic show.
explanation_ru: Слово child имеет неправильную форму множественного числа — children.

prompt: During the snowstorm on the farm, we carried warm buckets past wet (leaf) to keep the thirsty (sheep) comfortable.
explanation_ru: Слово leaf меняет -f на -ves (leaves), а sheep не изменяется во множественном числе.

prompt: The police (have) finally found the twelve beach umbrellas that two (thief) took from the seaside shop.
explanation_ru: Существительное the police всегда согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (have), а thief во множественном числе даёт thieves.

prompt: These new brown glasses (feel) so light that the retired baker can finally read tiny cake recipes clearly.
explanation_ru: Слово glasses (очки) всегда имеет форму множественного числа, поэтому глагол употребляется без -s (feel).

prompt: Tariq is worried because his running shoes hurt his (foot), while his cousin's spare pair (be) still at home.
explanation_ru: Множественное число от foot — feet, а подлежащее pair (одна пара) требует глагола в единственном числе (is).

prompt: Why do online shops send four huge cardboard (box) when the ordered goods (fit) inside one small cup?
explanation_ru: После -x добавляется -es (boxes), а слово goods (товары) всегда требует глагола во множественном числе (fit).

prompt: "Both of my (brother-in-law) used brown paper, and somehow these heavy metal tools inside our wedding box (weigh) almost five kilos!"
explanation_ru: В составных существительных с предлогом окончание -s добавляется к главному слову (brothers-in-law), а с tools глагол стоит во множественном числе (weigh).

prompt: When Kertu spotted her family's old wool shawl inside the glass case, several curious (passer-by) stopped to hear how village (woman) once wove it.
explanation_ru: В сложном слове passer-by во множественное число ставится первая часть (passers-by), а woman образует неправильную форму women.

prompt: The morning traffic news (sound) terrible for local drivers because a stuck bridge hinge has trapped sixty delivery (lorry) near the harbour.
explanation_ru: Существительное news всегда единственного числа и требует -s у глагола (sounds), а lorry во множественном числе меняется на lorries.

prompt: "Luckily, no (mouse) chewed through Mum's old board games up here, though Dad's old striped trousers (need) a good wash!"
explanation_ru: Слово mouse имеет неправильное множественное число mice, а trousers всегда согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (need).

prompt: Two brothers run a busy pizza shop in Naples. On Friday evening, hungry (person) filled all the tables near the wood oven. Their grandmother quickly brought fresh basil and sweet red (tomato) down from her sunny balcony.
explanation_ru: Во множественном числе person заменяется на people, а tomato получает окончание -es (tomatoes).

prompt: A worried tourist ran across a quiet square in Bruges. "I think my bag is stolen, and the police (be) the only ones who can help!" he shouted. Two kind local (man) checked under all the cafe (bench) without finding anything. A moment later, his younger brother walked out of the toilet wearing the missing bag.
explanation_ru: С the police используется глагол are, man меняется на men, а существительное на -ch образует множественное число с -es (benches).

prompt: My grandmother never shops without a written list at our local market in Valencia. First, we look for the stall with the sweetest (cherry) and freshest (potato). My market clothes always (get) dusty before we even head home. Even so, we come back with full bags and big smiles.
explanation_ru: Cherry меняется на cherries, potato — на potatoes, а clothes всегда требует глагола во множественном числе (get).

prompt: Autumn has brought a huge harvest to Hugh's pear farm in Kent. He has already stacked seventy full wooden boxes beside the barn door. Tomorrow, nearby village (family) will come to pick extra fruit from the low (branch). Hugh also keeps the fence shut because hungry wild (deer) sometimes wander in at night.
explanation_ru: Family образует множественное число с -ies (families), branch — с -es (branches), а форма слова deer не меняется.

prompt: Woodwork class in Derby is never quiet when eighteen pupils build birdhouses. Before the bell rings, the teacher checks that the metal scissors always (stay) on the two wooden (shelf). Today, two cheerful (child) somehow created a giant mountain of curly wood shavings. Everyone helped sweep the floor before lunch.
explanation_ru: Слово scissors требует глагола во множественном числе (stay), shelf меняется на shelves, а child — на children.

prompt: I have to tell you what happened at my job interview in Milan! My own smart clothes never (fit) properly, so I borrowed a navy jacket from one of my (sister-in-law). Everything went smoothly until the manager spotted a bright white laundry tag still pinned to the sleeve. Luckily, he laughed and said embarrassing moments make the best (story) later.
explanation_ru: Clothes согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (fit), в составном sister-in-law -s добавляется к sister (sisters-in-law), а story даёт stories.

prompt: Poor Declan made a hilarious mistake in our village bakery chat in Cork. He meant to tell three hundred customers that warm bread (loaf) were ready at the counter. Instead, he sent his private shopping list for cat food, onions, and paste for sensitive (tooth)! Somehow the funny news always (spread) across the whole town faster than his cakes sell.
explanation_ru: Loaf меняется на loaves, tooth имеет неправильную форму teeth, а неисчисляемое news требует глагола в единственном числе (spreads).

prompt: Our family loves visiting the evening street market in Penang under warm paper flags. At our favourite stall, the cooks grill fresh (fish) and slice sweet yellow (mango) right beside the road. Although the busy crowd looks loud at first, the local people always (welcome) visitors with warm smiles. My two hungry sons never leave a single noodle behind.
explanation_ru: Слово fish в значении еды/улова обычно не меняется, mango образует форму mangoes, а people всегда согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (welcome).

prompt: Nick's witty notice asks customers to check if ___ still hiding inside the blue washer.
explanation_ru: Слово trousers всегда употребляется во множественном числе с глаголом are; ошибка trousers is возникает из-за переноса с единственного числа.

prompt: Hannah's note tells her aunt to feed the goats and ___ before locking the gate.
explanation_ru: У слова sheep единственное и множественное число совпадают; добавление -s (sheeps) — частая ошибка.

prompt: "Could you ask both of your ___ not to touch the glass cases?" Klaus said gently.
explanation_ru: После both of требуется множественное число; правильная форма от child — children, а не childs или childrens.

prompt: "Don't worry any longer, because the news from our pool cleaner ___ wonderful—we found your father's watch!"
explanation_ru: Существительное news в английском языке неисчисляемое и всегда согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе (is), несмотря на -s на конце.

prompt: Pavel wrote an ironic review saying he had never seen ___ waste so much time interviewing candidates to water office plants.
explanation_ru: В составном существительном grown-up без главного существительного окончание -s ставится в конце слова (grown-ups).

prompt: After sliding onto the wet grass, the boy laughed because his pyjamas was muddy.
answer: After sliding onto the wet grass, the boy laughed because his pyjamas were muddy.
accepted_answers: After sliding onto the wet grass, the boy laughed because his pyjamas were muddy.
explanation_ru: Слово pyjamas всегда множественного числа, поэтому требуется форма were; употребление was — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Farid reported that the missing goods on the loading ramp was never signed for by the driver.
answer: Farid reported that the missing goods on the loading ramp were never signed for by the driver.
accepted_answers: Farid reported that the missing goods on the loading ramp were never signed for by the driver.
explanation_ru: Слово goods (товары) всегда согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (were), а не was.

prompt: We counted fourteen black swans and several silver fish swimming right beside the wooden viewing deck.
answer: We counted fourteen black swans and several silver fish swimming right beside the wooden viewing deck.
accepted_answers: We counted fourteen black swans and several silver fish swimming right beside the wooden viewing deck.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: слово fish во множественном числе верно оставлено без окончания -es.

prompt: Claire emailed her supplier to complain that the new lab scissors does not cut filter paper cleanly enough for Friday's tests.
answer: Claire emailed her supplier to complain that the new lab scissors do not cut filter paper cleanly enough for Friday's tests.
accepted_answers: Claire emailed her supplier to complain that the new lab scissors do not cut filter paper cleanly enough for Friday's tests.
Claire emailed her supplier to complain that the new lab scissors don't cut filter paper cleanly enough for Friday's tests.
explanation_ru: Существительное scissors всегда множественного числа, поэтому с ним нужен вспомогательный глагол do, а не does.

prompt: A cellist has only one matching set of black concert shoes, and she left them in her cousin's car boot. Which sentence fits?
options: Her pair of concert shoes is still locked in the car boot.
Her pair of concert shoes are still locked in the car boot.
Her pairs of concert shoes are still locked in the car boot.
Her black concert shoe is still locked in the car boot.
explanation_ru: Речь об одной паре туфель: подлежащее pair стоит в единственном числе и требует глагола is.

prompt: Julien's wedding guests are waiting outside the village bakery and feel relieved to hear fresh tarts are baking. Which sentence fits?
options: The peoples outside the village bakery are relieved that fresh tarts will arrive before noon.
The people outside the village bakery is relieved that fresh tarts will arrive before noon.
The people outside the village bakery are relieved that fresh tarts will arrive before noon.
The person outside the village bakery are relieved that fresh tarts will arrive before noon.
explanation_ru: Слово people (люди) согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (are), а peoples означает «народы».

prompt: That elderly woman waits at the village stop with her umbrella. → Those elderly …
answer: Those elderly women wait at the village stop with their umbrellas.
accepted_answers: Those elderly women wait at the village stop with their umbrellas.
explanation_ru: При переводе во множественное число woman меняется на women, а глагол и притяжательное местоимение согласуются во множественном числе (wait, their umbrellas).

prompt: Although Linh's parents packed plenty of snacks, these grey wool trousers are still too heavy for the small suitcase. → Although Linh's parents packed plenty of snacks, this pair of grey wool trousers …
answer: Although Linh's parents packed plenty of snacks, this pair of grey wool trousers is still too heavy for the small suitcase.
accepted_answers: Although Linh's parents packed plenty of snacks, this pair of grey wool trousers is still too heavy for the small suitcase.
explanation_ru: При замене trousers на this pair of trousers подлежащим становится слово pair в единственном числе, поэтому are меняется на is.
